messages:
emily: Quick flag — Acme onboarding is showing an embed-heavy burst after the semantic search rollout. QBR cost slide due EOW, can we get numbers + a short playbook? :eyes:

raj: Heads-up — I ran a quick rollup. Daily token burn spiked the day they switched to batched embedding jobs.

carlos: Can you drop the figures here so I can build the slide?

raj: ```
account: acme
7d avg tokens/day: 48,200
peak single-day: 190,000
embeddings % of cost: 63%
predicted EOW spend (no mitigation): $6,400
```

sophie: Oof. Their renewal alert threshold is $5k/mo for this tier. We should propose a short-term credit buffer and an enablement/runbook to prevent repeat surges.

emily: Agreed. Proposed rapid plan: 
- short-term: apply a 20% embed throttle on non-critical routes and add rate-limit annotations to the integration docs
- mid-term: enable prefix/KV caching and recommend quantized model variant for embeddings
- QBR slide: forecast table + top 3 playbook items + ask (credits or retainer) :white_check_mark:

raj: I can run a 30-day forecast with route-level breakdown and scenario runs (+10%, +30%, throttle). Assigning to @raj. Expect a CSV output.

carlos: I'll mock the slide. Need: 1) per-route token chart, 2) suggested throttle settings, 3) cost impact table (current vs mitigated). If raj can drop the CSV by Thu AM that helps.

sophie: I'll lock an enablement session with their PM/Eng for Wed 10am. Also will capture integration feedback — looks like a retry loop caused a backfill.

emily: Excellent. Action items: raj -> forecast (due Thu EOD), carlos -> slide draft (Thu noon), sophie -> enablement invite + feedback capture (Tue COB). I'll raise a renewal flag if the forecast goes over $8k.

runbook-bot: Created ticket CS-1128 for credits buffer approval and linked the thread. :robot_face:

emily: Thanks team — please add brief notes in the ticket when you drop numbers. We'll keep the QBR conservative and show projected savings with the throttle + cache plan.
